tools.name: endpoint.accounting.supplier_scorecard
tools.description: Score one supplier (party_id) or every supplier on on-time delivery, quality and price drift, with each source reported incomplete rather than zeroed when not permitted. Read-only.

party_id.description: Party id of the supplier to score; blank returns every supplier.

tools.name: endpoint.agent.skill.export
tools.description: POST /api/agent/skill/export

skill_id.description: Id of the AgentSkill version to export. Takes precedence over persona_id/persona_name.

persona_id.description: AgentPersona id; exports that persona's active Skill. Used when skill_id is absent.

persona_name.description: AgentPersona name (exact match); used when skill_id and persona_id are both absent.

tools.name: endpoint.agent.tasks.run
tools.description: Launch one of your own scheduled agent tasks now (body: task_id). Owner-only; a task owned by another user is refused.

task_id.description: Id of an AgentTask you own. Another user's task is refused.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.skill_sandbox
tools.description: POST /api/agent-governance/skill-sandbox

persona_id.description: AgentPersona to compare. Omit to get only the persona picker page.

candidate_skill_id.description: Stored AgentSkill version to compare against the persona's live prompt. Ignored when candidate_markdown is given.

candidate_markdown.description: Pasted SKILL.md text to compare. Wins over candidate_skill_id. Max 200000 characters.

candidate_policy_id.description: AgentToolPolicy id to compare against the persona's current policy, or '__none__' to compare with no policy.

persona_offset.description: Offset into the active-persona picker (page size 25). Default 0.

skill_offset.description: Offset into the persona's Skill versions (page size 50). Default 0.

policy_offset.description: Offset into the active tool-policy picker (page size 25). Default 0.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.privacy
tools.description: GET /api/agent-governance/privacy

offset.description: Offset into the conversation list (page size fixed by the script). Default 0.

session_id.description: AgentSession id to select; adds its forget plan, class suggestion and privacy receipts.

privacy_class.description: Filter conversations by stored privacy class, e.g. unclassified, internal, personal, sensitive.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.privacy.forget.preview
tools.description: POST /api/agent-governance/privacy/forget/preview

session_id.description: AgentSession whose derived memories would be erased.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.escalations
tools.description: GET /api/agent-governance/escalations

view.description: Which escalations to list. Default 'open'; unknown values fall back to 'open'.

offset.description: Offset into the inbox page (page size 15). Default 0.

escalation_id.description: Escalation id to return in full under `selected`, even if outside the current page.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.escalations.assignees
tools.description: GET /api/agent-governance/escalations/assignees

q.description: Case-insensitive name search over assignable people (active sign-ins linked to a Party).

search.description: Alias of q; used only when q is empty.

offset.description: Offset into the result page (page size 25). Default 0.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.escalations.raise
tools.description: POST /api/agent-governance/escalations/raise

session_id.description: AgentSession (conversation) to hand to a person; the agent is stopped on it.

assignee_party_id.description: Party id of the named human owner; must be visible to you and linked to an active sign-in.

reason.description: What the person needs to know first; required.

reason_code.description: Categorised reason. Default 'unresolved_after_retries'; unknown values become 'other'.

sla_minutes.description: Response SLA in minutes; snapped to the nearest of 15, 30, 60, 120, 240, 480, 1440. Default 60.

tools.name: endpoint.agent_governance.escalations.update
tools.description: POST /api/agent-governance/escalations/update

expect_status.description: Optimistic-concurrency guard: the status you last read (open, acknowledged, resolved, withdrawn); a mismatch returns a conflict.

note.description: Resolution note; required when action is 'resolve'.

outcome.description: Resolution outcome for resolve/withdraw; unknown values fall back to the default for the action.

tools.name: endpoint.approvals.process_decision
tools.description: Process an approve/reject decision for an approval step

decision.description: Decision to record; defaults to approved.

comments.description: Decision comments stored on the step, history and final_comments.

level.description: Approval level to decide at; defaults to the request's current_level.

tools.name: endpoint.crm.campaign_audiences
tools.description: GET /api/crm/campaign-audiences

tools.name: endpoint.crm.campaign_audiences.preview
tools.description: POST /api/crm/campaign-audiences/preview

tools.name: endpoint.crm.account_plans
tools.description: GET /api/crm/account-plans

tools.name: endpoint.crm.call_note_sources
tools.description: GET /api/crm/call-note-sources

tools.name: endpoint.crm.call_notes
tools.description: GET /api/crm/call-notes

tools.name: endpoint.email.rfq.create_quote
tools.description: Create a draft quotation and design records from selected clean attachments on a tenant-owned RFQ email. This endpoint never sends the message or a quotation.

tools.name: endpoint.email.public.subscriber_lists
tools.description: GET /api/email/public/subscriber-lists

list_id.description: Return only this SubscriberList (still only if it is public). Omit to list all public lists.

tools.name: endpoint.email.messages.send
tools.description: Send one of your stored email messages through the real send path: a draft, or a failed message (retry). Pass scheduled_send_at (ISO with offset) to queue it instead. Refused with 503 when your mailbox has no outbound SMTP transport; the message is then kept in the Outbox as failed.

message_id.description: Id of your stored draft or failed EmailMessage.

scheduled_send_at.description: Optional ISO datetime with offset; queues the send instead of sending now.

tools.name: endpoint.inventory.shipping_board
tools.description: Dispatch planning board: open SalesOrder lines due to ship by promised date and customer, with ordered/delivered/remaining quantities and their DeliveryChallans. Read-only.

tools.name: endpoint.job_ledger.forensics
tools.description: GET /api/job-ledger/forensics

limit.description: Jobs per page; clamped to 1..50. Default 20.

offset.description: Offset into jobs, newest first; negative clamps to 0. Default 0.

status.description: Filter jobs by exact AgentJob status.

tools.name: endpoint.job_ledger.verify
tools.description: POST /api/job-ledger/verify

job_id.description: AgentJob whose ledger chain and seals to verify (read-only).

tools.name: endpoint.job_ledger.replay
tools.description: POST /api/job-ledger/replay

job_id.description: AgentJob to replay against its recorded tool calls (read-only).

tools.name: endpoint.job_ledger.retention.preview
tools.description: POST /api/job-ledger/retention/preview

job_id.description: AgentJob whose step ledger the plan covers.

tools.name: endpoint.manufacturing.demand_forecast
tools.description: Demand forecast: per item, the monthly average of real sales-order history plus committed open-order demand, for the next horizon months. Read-only.

tools.name: endpoint.manufacturing.label
tools.description: Label: a printable item or job label whose scannable QR encodes the item code (resolved by the scan catalogue) or the Floor deep link, generated locally.

kind.description: item = a part's code label; job = an operation label on the Floor deep link. Default item.

tools.name: endpoint.make.orders
tools.description: Orders: one row per open Sales Order line — customer, item, quantity, promised and projected dates, stage, top blocker and owner. Paged: total, has_more and next_offset say when rows remain (limit up to 500). Read-only; requires SalesOrder read.

owner.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for the named order owner.

offset.description: Rows to skip. Use next_offset from the previous page.

tools.name: endpoint.make.thread
tools.description: Read the caller-scoped order thread for a SalesOrder, including linked manufacturing, inspection, shipping and invoice records plus expected missing nodes. Unreadable linked entities are redacted. Read-only; requires SalesOrder read.

entity.description: Thread root entity. Only SalesOrder is supported in this release.

tools.name: endpoint.manufacturing.purchase_price_variance
tools.description: C-107 — compare paid/open PO bills with the frozen standard in force on receipt date.

tools.name: endpoint.manufacturing.standard_cost_rolls.frozen
tools.description: C-107 — read frozen standard-cost snapshots; drafts are never returned.

tools.name: endpoint.manufacturing.standard_cost_rolls.drafts
tools.description: C-107 — read proposed standard-cost snapshots for roles authorized to freeze them.

tools.name: endpoint.manufacturing.job_margin
tools.description: C-105 — read-only SalesOrder-line revenue and manufacturing cost projection joined by stable line key.

sales_order_id.description: SalesOrder whose line margins to read.

tools.name: endpoint.mission_control.staffing_forecast
tools.description: POST /api/mission-control/staffing-forecast

horizon_hours.description: Forecast horizon in hours (default 24; clamped to 1-168).

observation_days.description: Days of job history to observe (default 14; clamped to 1-90).

added_workers.description: Hypothetical extra active personas to add (default 0; clamped to 0-50).

per_persona_concurrency.description: Scenario per-persona concurrency (default: current floor config; clamped to 1-1000).

global_concurrency.description: Scenario global concurrency cap (default: current floor config; clamped to 1-10000).

tools.name: endpoint.mission_control.incidents
tools.description: GET /api/mission-control/incidents

observation_days.description: Look-back window in days (default 14; clamped by positive_int).

include_healthy.description: Also include incident groups with no failure (default false).

tools.name: endpoint.mission_control.incident_timeline
tools.description: GET /api/mission-control/incident-timeline

correlation_id.description: Correlation id of the incident (job chain) to build the timeline for.

tools.name: endpoint.mission_control.runbooks
tools.description: GET /api/mission-control/runbooks

status.description: Optional AgentRunbook status filter (exact match, e.g. draft, pending_approval, approved).

tools.name: endpoint.people_directory
tools.description: N146. A names-only people directory any member may read: employee id, name and department, and NOTHING else (no salary, bank, statutory id, address or date of birth). The Task/assignee picker and the MCP tool read it instead of the HR-only Employee list.

tools.name: endpoint.calendar.birthdays
tools.description: GET /api/calendar/birthdays

start.description: Window start, ISO-8601 date (first 10 chars used). Default: now minus 30 days.

end.description: Window end, ISO-8601 date (first 10 chars used). Default: now plus 365 days.

tools.name: endpoint.public.collective.meta
tools.description: GET /api/public/collective/meta

slug.description: Public link name of the collective meeting type.

days.description: Horizon in days (clamped to 0-60; 0/omitted uses the type's default).

tools.name: endpoint.public.collective.book
tools.description: POST /api/public/collective/book

slug.description: Public link name of the collective meeting type.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key, at least 8 characters; reuse it on retries of the same request.

start_time.description: Chosen slot start, ISO-8601 instant from the offered slots (naive = UTC).

tools.name: endpoint.public.collective.waitlist
tools.description: POST /api/public/collective/waitlist

slug.description: Public link name of the collective meeting type.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key, at least 8 characters; reuse it on retries of the same request.

earliest_start.description: Optional earliest acceptable start, ISO-8601 instant.

latest_start.description: Optional latest acceptable start, ISO-8601 instant; after earliest_start.

tools.name: endpoint.public.collective.claim
tools.description: POST /api/public/collective/claim

offer_id.description: Id of the slot offer from the claim link.

claim_token.description: Claim token from the claim link.

idempotency_key.description: Client-chosen key, at least 8 characters; reuse it on retries.

guest_name.description: Optional; defaults to the name on the waitlist entry.

guest_email.description: Optional; defaults to the email on the waitlist entry.

guest_timezone.description: Optional; defaults to the waitlist entry's timezone.

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.products
tools.description: GET /api/storefront/products

limit.description: Page size (default 20; capped at 200; negatives become 0).

search.description: Case-insensitive substring over name, code, sku, short_description.

ids.description: Comma-separated product ids to resolve at once (max 50 used). Takes precedence over slug/code/id.

slug.description: Address one product by slug (first of slug, code, id that is set wins).

category.description: Category slug filter (takes precedence over category_id).

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.categories
tools.description: GET /api/storefront/categories

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.locale
tools.description: GET /api/storefront/locale

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.shipping_methods
tools.description: GET /api/storefront/shipping-methods

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.checkout
tools.description: POST /api/storefront/checkout

customer_email.description: Shopper's email; must look like name@domain.tld.

shipping_method_id.description: Optional ShippingMethod id (from GET /api/storefront/shipping-methods); server resolves the charge.

payment_method.description: Optional payment method label stored on the order (provider is decided by tenant settings, not this).

coupon_code.description: Optional coupon code; validated and priced server-side.

items.description: Cart lines (1-50). Prices are never accepted; the server prices from the catalogue.

source_webpage_id.description: Optional website page id that referred the shopper (ws_page); verified against the published layout, dropped if >100 chars.

source_section_key.description: Optional website section key that referred the shopper (ws_section); verified, dropped if >120 chars.

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.payment.verify
tools.description: POST /api/storefront/payment/verify

order_token.description: Order access token returned by checkout (order_token).

outcome.description: Simulated payment outcome (default success). abandoned cancels the order.

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.order
tools.description: GET /api/storefront/order

order_token.description: Order access token issued at checkout.

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.order.claim
tools.description: POST /api/storefront/order/claim

order_number.description: Order number shown on the confirmation page (give this or order_id).

order_token.description: Order access token from the confirmation link.

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.account.orders
tools.description: GET /api/storefront/account/orders

tools.name: endpoint.storefront.notify_me
tools.description: POST /api/storefront/notify-me

item_id.description: Published, sellable Item id to be notified about.

email.description: Shopper email; must look like name@domain.tld.

consent.description: Must be true: shopper consents to an email about this product.

tools.name: EmailMessage.send_email
tools.description: Send an email from a mailbox you own (or schedule it with delay_seconds / scheduled_send_at).

mailbox_id.description: Mailbox to send from (must be yours).

to.description: One address, or a list of {email, name} recipients.

body_text.description: Plain-text body (derived from HTML when omitted).

thread_id.description: Existing EmailThread id to append to.

delay_seconds.description: Queue the send this many seconds from now (undo window).

scheduled_send_at.description: Explicit ISO-8601 send time; queues the message.

tools.name: EmailMessage.reply
tools.description: Reply to one of your messages. The mailbox, recipient, subject and threading are taken from the original; you give the text.

body_html.description: Optional HTML version of the reply.

reply_all.description: Also copy everyone else on the original (default false).

tools.name: EmailCampaign.send
tools.description: Send a draft, scheduled or paused campaign to its list's active subscribers. The send engine moves it to sending and then sent; watch it with EmailCampaign.get. Refused (409) when the campaign was already sent or its list has no active subscribers.

tools.name: AgentTask.run_now
tools.description: Run an agent task immediately.

tools.name: AgentPersona.daily_limits
tools.description: Tokens and USD spend each agent persona you can see has used today against its daily limits (tokens_used_today / daily_token_budget, spend_today_usd / daily_llm_budget_usd), what remains, whether it is blocked, when the limits reset (00:00 UTC), and totals. Read-only; only an admin can change a limit.

tools.name: TeamHarness.get_mine
tools.description: Read your team's harness link (GitHub repository, branch, note). Returns harness: null when none is set yet.

tools.name: TeamHarness.set_mine
tools.description: Create or replace your team's harness link. repo_url must be https://github.com/<owner>/<repo> (no /tree/..., query or token); put the branch in `branch`. Empty branch/note clears them.

branch.description: Optional branch name, e.g. main ('' clears it).

note.description: Optional: what your harness does ('' clears it).

tools.name: tools.search
tools.description: Search the tools available to you for a business object or verb, e.g. 'purchase order', 'WO complete', 'stock availability'. Returns the matching tool names with a one-line description, ranked. Use tools.describe for the input schema before calling.

query.description: Words or an abbreviation (PO, WO, QI, MR).

module.description: Restrict to one module, e.g. manufacturing.

risk.description: Restrict by the tool's risk class.

tools.name: tools.describe
tools.description: Return the full input schema (and description) for tool names you already know, so you can call them without fetching the whole catalogue. Names outside your scope are reported as not available.

tools.name: tools.preview
tools.description: Preview a transition or document-chain tool before calling it: returns the records it would create, the stock/GL it would post, blockers with codes, and its risk class. Nothing is written. Pass the tool name and the arguments you would call it with; the same works by adding preview: true to the call itself.

name.description: A transition or *.make.* tool you may call.

arguments.description: The record id, as for the call.

tools.name: events.catalog
tools.description: List the manufacturing and inventory events you can automate on: name, what it means, its payload fields and how to listen (an Automation with trigger_event on_event). Read-only.
